purpose: Formal deprecation and permanent elimination of non-empirical, speculative, or pseudo-scientific cognitive profiling metrics in accordance with DPDP Act 2023 §9 and educational measurement standards.

prunedMetrics.rationale: Speculative pseudo-scientific claim purporting to model an internalized brain-simulation or duplicate of the child's mind. Lacks empirical psychometric grounding, introduces ethical opacity, and violates data minimization.
prunedMetrics.replacement: Corbett & Anderson Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) probability P(L_t) with deterministic item parameters (P(L0), P(T), P(G), P(S)).

prunedMetrics.rationale: Learning Styles (Visual, Auditory, Reading, Kinesthetic) have been repeatedly debunked in cognitive science literature (Pashler et al., 2008) as harmful categorization that artificially limits student agency without pedagogical benefit.
prunedMetrics.replacement: Prerequisite Concept DAG traversal and multi-modal Hint Scaffolding (Conceptual -> Strategic -> Concrete) accessible to all learners.

prunedMetrics.rationale: Unfalsifiable inference of neural engagement or attention level derived from mouse tracking, webcam video, or keystroke timing, which infringes child privacy under DPDP §9 without clinical calibration.
prunedMetrics.replacement: Transparent behavioral metrics: empirical response latency (seconds) and mistake taxonomy categorization.

prunedMetrics.rationale: Unreliable facial/sentiment guessing algorithms prone to demographic and cultural bias, completely inappropriate for child educational governance.
prunedMetrics.replacement: Explicit teacher observations, deterministic hint progression, and student-initiated assistance requests.

prunedMetrics.rationale: Static profiling suggesting fixed cognitive ability violates growth-mindset pedagogical guidelines and risks self-fulfilling educational ceilings.
prunedMetrics.replacement: Dynamic, malleable knowledge state estimation that updates continuously with deliberate practice and remediation.

complianceInvariants: Every metric driving personalization MUST be directly observable, mathematically falsifiable, and auditable by teachers.
No AI agent may generate psychological diagnoses or neurological classifications.
All mastery estimates are bounded probabilities [0.0, 1.0] derived from validated Bayesian formulations.
